summary: Frontend-only regression of the new 'always-online with automatic backup' behavior. All 6 requested scenarios verified with Playwright on the preview URL as admin. Dashboard now shows the new 'Sempre online, con backup automatico' card with the reload-cache-btn; the old mode-cloud-btn/mode-pwa-btn are gone. Login persistence offline works: page.reload() while offline keeps the user on the Dashboard (no redirect to /auth) and the orange offline-banner appears. Cached read-only pages (Events / News / Chat / Reminders) render offline from the SW cache (noi-shell-v4 + noi-api-v4, including /api/orario). Going back online (dispatching 'online' event) removes the banner within ~3s without reload. Reload-cache-btn triggers page reload and comes back to Dashboard with the button still present.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.throwIt(): the empty-target check (line 53) runs BEFORE requireOnline() (line 54). If user is offline AND hasn't selected a target, they see 'Scegli prima un compagno' rather than the offline toast. Minor UX ordering nit; requireOnline should probably run first so offline users always see a consistent 'sei offline' message. Not blocking.

AuthContext.load(): when offline AND no cached user exists but a token is present, setUser(false) forces logout — acceptable fallback, but could optionally keep the token and show a 'riprova quando torni online' state. Not required by spec.

Layout cache-warming useEffect depends on loc.pathname which will re-fire the same 4 fetches on every navigation while online. Fine (browser dedupes fresh requests) but could be memoised on interval instead.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SW registers automatically on every login; caches are noi-shell-v4 + noi-api-v4 and include /api/orario. To reproduce offline flow: login -> visit /events /news /chat to warm cache (~2-4s wait) -> page.context.set_offline(True) -> page.reload() -> user stays on Dashboard with offline-banner visible. To force banner removal after going back online without full reload, dispatch 'online' event since useOnline hook listens for it: await page.evaluate("window.dispatchEvent(new Event('online'))"). Write actions are code-guarded by requireOnline() in Events/Chat/CoursePanel/Reminders/News/Messaggi/Dashboard as reported by main agent; offline write blocking on chat input is enforced by disabling the input (fill timed out because it's disabled — expected behavior, not a bug).
